text: At e<=0.9, force's best layer differs by seed (4/1/2), and its normalised margin is 0.14-0.25 against 0.32-0.36 for accel_step. Is the ratio of normalised force margin to normalised accel_step margin (0.47/0.44/0.76 here) the same at e<=0.85 for seeds 70-72 at 3000 steps? If it is, force decodability is tracking accel_step rather than declining on its own at high eccentricity.
